skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Recognize similarities and differences between two languages.
Compare vocabulary on class topics for translation purposes.
Expand translation techniques for various translation purposes.
Analyze and understand source text before translating.
Adapt translation techniques flexibly based on context and purpose.
Combine grammar and vocabulary knowledge during translation.
Develop self-study and practice habits to improve translation abilities.
Understand the importance of responsibility and professional ethics in translation work.
Create a personal translation dictionary with terms and analysis techniques.
